title: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core, 16-Thread Desktop Processor $569.54 Delivered @ Amazon DE via AU
body:
Deal: AMD Ryzen 7 9800X3D 8-Core, 16-Thread Desktop Processor $569.54 Delivered @ Amazon DE via AU

[cloudie9] New model CPU 10000 series coming out probably late this year or early next year if you want to wait.
Sauce?
[UncertainRandomness] Mostly just rumours that AMD is planning to release them during CES 2027 early next year based on their usual release cycle.
[goodwillN1] Might be reliable given the server version is already released.
[boozed] If it follows naming established since Zen 2, 10000 should be a Zen 5 APU
[hairyfrog] also 9850x3d for $614.20
https://www.amazon.com.au/dp/B0G8JMLXNQ
[Grey 13] If that's old then my Ryzen 7900 is ancient lol
But considering how AM4 refused to die, I guess we're all immortal at this point lol
[eddyah] Not that AM4 refuses to die, it's that DDR5 prices are keeping it alive.
[ONEMariachi] If that's old then my Ryzen 7900 is ancient lol
and my 3700AxE
[El Psy Kongroo] Perhaps fear-mongering. A lot of people still use AM4 so it's very unlikely that AMD would release AM6 anytime soon.
[Aliensf] Buy now, everything is going up. stick with 32GB ram, any will do with this CPU since its an X3D
[cdaddy] Meh this was just last week https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/971685 + the cashback
[winaxter] Massive difference amazon warranty vs. ali express lottery
[goodwillN1] But from what I hear, the AliExpress lottery mostly has winners. Yes it is more of a risk, but fairly low if you go with one of the known sellers.
[MaxHashrate] If you heading overseas, buy from Woolworths everyday when they run the 30% cashback from shop back. Then TRS 10% refund.
I managed to get it for under $490 and Australian warranty boxed version.
Super light and easy to bring
[bruhminister] If you travel internationally, you can claim something purchased in the 60 days before travel as a gift and get the 10% gst back.
Bringing it back in the country would be illegal if not declared.. but.. you know..
Super light and easy to bring
[evilbamboo] for those who is trying, you don't even need the box for TRS, just tax invoice
[Morien] @evilbamboo: Usually they want to see it to make sure you have it in person. The refund is, after all, for goods bought here and taken overseas.
And for a CPU, I wouldn’t carry it loosely in my pocket. Take the box.
[MaxHashrate] U don't have to declare it if it is under your $900 allowance (per person, kids $450). If U open the box and the seal is gone, the value amount is reduced when calculating the $900.
Done it heaps of time. Just don't try claiming a $2k iPhone if travelling alone.
